*New Jacksonville location expands PharmcoRx's statewide network with contracted services for 340B providers, long-term care facilities and specialty pharmacy patients*


HALLANDALE BEACH, Fla. and JACKSONVILLE, Fla.


, Oct. 13, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- NextPlat Corp (NASDAQ: NXPL) ("NextPlat" or the "Company"), a global consumer products and services company providing healthcare and technology solutions through e-commerce and retail channels worldwide, today announced the opening of a new[PharmcoRx](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4795727-1&h=2651356836&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.pharmcorx.com%2F&a=PharmcoRx) community pharmacy in Jacksonville, Florida.


Located at 3604 University Blvd South, Suite 102, the new pharmacy is directly across from the HCA Florida Memorial Hospital with multiple specialty medical practices and healthcare service providers nearby and offers convenient access to major southside Jacksonville business and residential areas.


"The opening of our new Jacksonville pharmacy in northern Florida further diversifies and complements our growing footprint. As we continue to grow our healthcare operations, we see the opening of new locations and selective acquisitions of well-established pharmacies as the ideal way to bring our unique combination of retail and higher-margin contracted services to underserved communities across Florida," said David Phipps, CEO of NextPlat.


PharmcoRx, NextPlat's dedicated healthcare services unit, currently operates a growing network of six retail pharmacies serving patients across Florida providing full-service prescription fulfillment, medication management, high-touch, same day delivery, and integrated patient support. It also provides a full suite of high-margin contracted services for healthcare providers and institutions including 340B, long-term care facilities and government agencies. By combining retail, specialty, institutional, 340B and government services, PharmcoRx can serve multiple patient populations and healthcare partners through a single pharmacy operation, differentiating itself from the traditional mass-market pharmacy chains.


Rodney Barreto, Chairman of NextPlat Corp, added, "Our expansion into rapidly growing Jacksonville, Florida, enables us to bring our high-quality PharmcoRx services to another vibrant community as we continue to expand across the state. We believe there is growing demand for high-quality, patient-centric healthcare services such as those delivered by PharmcoRx, creating significant growth opportunities for us in the in the months ahead."


PharmcoRx's Jacksonville location will feature a full array of integrated pharmacy solutions including:


- Full-service prescription fulfillment, medication management, delivery, patient support and coordination with healthcare providers.
- Higher-margin contracted services for healthcare providers participating in the government's 340B discounted drug pricing program which supports poor or underserved populations such as children's and sole community hospitals, hemophilia diagnostic treatment centers, HIV/sexually transmitted disease and family planning clinics, with prescription fulfillment, inventory management, claims administration, compliance support and reporting services.
- Services designed for long-term care, assisted living facilities, senior-care communities and other institutions including customized medication packaging, scheduled delivery, pharmacist oversight and medication administration support.
- Specialty pharmacy service for patients receiving complex or high-cost therapies through specialized dispensing, education, adherence monitoring and coordination with prescribers and insurers.


By offering a full array of integrated pharmacy services, PharmcoRx can diversify its business model and reduce its reliance on any one customer channel, creating several avenues for sustainable, long-term growth.

**About NextPlat Corp** NextPlat is a global consumer products and services company providing healthcare and technology solutions through e-commerce and retail channels worldwide. Through acquisitions, joint ventures, and collaborations, the Company seeks to provide access to high-quality healthcare and pharmacy services supporting patients, providers, institutions, and public-sector organizations and creating online sales channels for the sales of products to domestic and international consumers. Through its subsidiaries, NextPlat provides pharmacy and healthcare data management services and prescription fulfillment services in the United States and operates an e-commerce division offering voice, data, tracking, and IoT products and services worldwide.
